name: Sunshine
source:
A very short and low effort Arknights fanmade visual novel made using Ren'Py.

You finished all the works before weekend comes. As you wander around the ship, you find out a room that caught your interest. What lies inside that room?

[Edited from [url=https://pomegrana.itch.io/sunshine]Itch.io[/url]]
